title: Upgrade history row transitions
status: source repair and focused checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: Upgrade start captures the UUID returned by the platform_upgrade insert.
Success and failure update only that captured row while it is still started.
The error path no longer inserts a second failed row that leaves the partial unique started-row index occupied.
If a first-time migration creates platform_upgrade before a later step fails, the error handler creates and closes that run's row.
Post-upgrade health timeout explicitly invokes the failure transition instead of relying on the ERR trap for an exit builtin.

specific_cases: Static regression verifies the captured run ID is used for the started-to-terminal transition.
Failure and success paths transition the exact row and the old latest-started lookup is absent.
The health-timeout path calls the failure handler explicitly.
Backup tamper detection and rollback confirmation regressions pass.

scope_limits: No candidate or legacy database was contacted and no upgrade or rollback was executed.
Live migration failure, backup restore, rollback, and release checksum parity remain unassessed.
CAP-052 remains unaccepted pending end-to-end upgrade and recovery parity plus MAN-CAP-052 review.
